meta.name: support-operations
meta.description: Designs and runs the support function — channels, queues, routing, staffing, service levels, quality, and the metrics that show whether it is working. Use this to set up or fix support operations, choose channels, size a team, set or renegotiate service levels, reduce cost per contact, diagnose long queues or poor quality, or decide what to automate.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建并优化客服支持流程,降低单次联系成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在管理客服团队并想优化服务流程与成本。
copy.tagline_en: Design and optimize your support operations to cut costs and improve service.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a support team and want to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

howto.what: 装上后，它会引导你按真实工单取样分析需求，用成本层级（消除/转移/自助/自动化/人工）处理问题，并设计渠道、服务水平、人员配置、指标和质检。
howto.when: 当你想搭建或修复客服体系、选择渠道或确定团队规模等运营议题时触发。

say.text: 分析最近 500 条客服工单，找出最常见的成因。
say.note: 它会逐条分类并指出可预防的联络源。

say.text: 我们首次响应太慢，该怎样调排班和服务水平？
say.note: 它会按高峰并发和实际产能来引导配置。
它会根据工作类型来建议渠道。

howto.what_en: Once installed, it will guide you to analyze real contact samples, handle issues through the cost hierarchy (eliminate/deflect/self-serve/automate/assist), and design channels, service levels, staffing, metrics, and quality review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to set up or fix support operations, choose channels, or size a team.

say_en.text: Analyze the last 500 support tickets and identify the most common root causes.
say_en.note: Claude classifies them and points out preventable contacts.

say_en.text: Our first response is too slow — how do we adjust staffing and SLAs?
say_en.note: Claude guides you by peak concurrency and actual capacity.

say_en.text: Which support channels should we use?
say_en.note: Claude recommends channels by the work needed.
